data.name: Rithanya
data.gender_notes: Rithanya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Rithanya is derived from the Tamil word 'Ritham' which means 'prosperity'. The suffix 'anya' means 'Goddess' in Sanskrit. Hence, the name Rithanya signifies the Goddess of prosperity. The name Rithanya carries the meaning “Goddess of prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Sanskrit, Kannada. Parents who choose Rithanya usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rithanya is a divine name that signifies the abundance and prosperity that is bestowed by the divine. It is a name that is revered by those who seek the blessings of the Goddess for a prosperous and abundant life.
data.etymology: Rithanya belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rithanya total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

historical_references.reference: Rithanya was a celebrated poet and scholar during the Chola dynasty (9th-13th century CE) in ancient India. He was renowned for his works on Tamil literature and is considered one of the greatest contributors to the Tamil language.

Another reference to Rithanya can be found in the inscriptions of the late Chola period (11th-12th century CE). He was a temple architect and is known to have built several temples, including the famous one at Thiruvenkadu, in the present day Tamil Nadu, India.
